title: Arts Portfolio Reviewer
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations' lives?

Crimson Education is a global EdTech company founded in 2013 with the idea that through personalised education and technology, we can transform students into the world leaders of tomorrow. We're the world's leading college admissions consultancy, with over 1,330 Ivy League offers and 2,140 to the US Top 15. With a passionate team of 800+ that's rapidly expanding across 30 markets, our unique tech platform connects expert-led guidance and proven data-driven strategies from 3,000 tutors and mentors with students worldwide. We help ambitious students unlock their dream career pathways, and Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League. What sets us apart is our unmatched scale and expertise. We have the largest team of Former Admissions Officers and College Counselors globally. Every student is matched with a carefully-chosen team of admissions experts who laser focus on different parts of their college application — from essays to extracurriculars — ensuring every detail is expertly executed. Valued at over $1B NZD and backed by over $147M NZD in funding from top-tier global investors, including Tiger Global and Ice House Ventures, we are just getting started. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal. Read the article here.
This is a contracted, fully remote position.  

What are the main responsibilities for this role?

  • Provide comprehensive and constructive feedback on students' portfolios for art  programmes, focusing on content and techniques.
  • Identify students' strengths and areas for improvement, offering strategic advice to enhance their portfolios and chances for admission
  • Stay informed about current trends and expectations at top art programmes in the US and UK to provide relevant guidance.
  • Maintain a high standard of professionalism and confidentiality in handling students' personal information and application materials.
  • Participate in Crimson Education's training to stay aligned with our goals, methodologies and technology development

What skills and experience are required?

  • A minimum of an arts or other relevant degree, including personal experience with portfolio construction
  • Experience in arts admissions, particularly with assessing applicant portfolios.
  • In-depth understanding of the admissions processes and expectations for arts programmes and expectations .
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to inspire students while providing rigorous and insightful feedback.
  • Proven track record of helping students succeed in competitive admissions settings
  • Ability to create a supportive and encouraging environment while maintaining high standards of critique.
  • Organisational skills to manage multiple arts portfolio reviews efficiently.

Why work for Crimson?

  • Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work
  • Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year
  • Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team
  • Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by
  • We're a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. 

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you
Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We're seeking a top-tier Executive Assistant for a dynamic asset management firm who excels at executive-level support and stakeholder coordination. This role demands someone who can seamlessly manage complex calendars, facilitate high-stakes meetings, and streamline operations for maximum efficiency.

You'll be the strategic right-hand supporting investment decisions, client relationships, and day-to-day operations in a fast-paced financial environment. If you're detail-oriented, proactive, and thrive on keeping executives laser-focused on what matters most, this is your opportunity.

Perks & Benefits

  • Paid in USD every 15th & 30th of the month
  • Up to 14 days of Paid Time Off per year
  • Flexible holiday observance based on your location
  • 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • Direct exposure to asset management and investment operations
  • Work with a results-driven team managing significant financial portfolios

What You'll Be Doing

  • Email & Calendar Management
    • Prioritize and manage the executive's inbox with strategic filtering
    • Coordinate complex calendars across multiple time zones and stakeholders
    • Schedule and reschedule meetings with investors, clients, and team members
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management
    • Serve as the primary point of contact between executives and key stakeholders
    • Draft professional correspondence and investor communications
    • Manage Slack channels and ensure timely response to critical messages
  • Meeting Management & Client Accountability
    • Prepare detailed meeting agendas and briefing materials
    • Send pre-meeting reminders with action items and expectations
    • Follow up post-meeting with accountability summaries and next steps
  • Workflow Optimization
    • Streamline daily operations and eliminate inefficiencies
    • Create and maintain standard operating procedures
    • Anticipate needs and proactively address potential roadblocks

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • RIA Compliance Knowledge - Understanding of regulated investment advisor requirements
  • Newsletter Creation - Design and distribute client updates and market insights
  • LinkedIn Management - Maintain executive profiles and engagement
  • Remote Event Coordination - Plan and execute virtual client events and webinars
  • Investor Updates - Assist with quarterly reports and investor communications
  • Content & Social Media - Basic content creation and social media oversight

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience supporting executives in financial services, asset management, or a similar high-stakes environment
  • Deep understanding of confidentiality and discretion required in financial settings
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational abilities with attention to detail
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates needs
  • Comfortable working with sensitive financial information

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right strategic fit:

  1. Initial Application - Submit application with relevant financial services experience
  2. One-way Video Interview - Record a brief video showcasing your executive support approach
  3. Practical Assessment - Complete a calendar management and communication challenge
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening focusing on financial services experience
  5. Executive Interview - Discuss role alignment, discretion, and workflow optimization
  6. Client Interview - Final interview covering stakeholder management and team collaboration
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification and compliance screening
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer with competitive compensation

We provide feedback at each stage and maintain transparent communication throughout the process.

title: Finance Analyst
description:
Objective of the role
The Finance Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analysis and structuring of financing transactions, assessing market rates, debt and equity alternatives, and applying advanced financial models. The position is expected to contribute to the design of financial strategies aligned with corporate goals, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality decision-making.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain financial models for corporate and project transactions, including the use of financing Model A.
  • Review and validate financial models prepared by external advisors, ensuring consistency with company assumptions and industry best practices.
  • Analyse and validate technical and financial assumptions together with specialised teams, assessing their impact on results.
  • Conduct market rate analysis and evaluate its effect on projects and financing structures.
  • Assess financing options (debt and equity), supporting the structuring and negotiation of alternatives.
  • Support capital raising processes (debt and equity), including the preparation of financial materials, participation in due diligence, and interaction with investors and financial institutions.
  • Prepare and contribute to capital presentations for investors, the board of directors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with internal departments (technical, legal, commercial) and external advisors to ensure timely and accurate information flow.
  • Conduct market and risk analysis to support investment and financing decisions.
  • Prepare financial reports, presentations, and executive summaries for management, investors, and other relevant audiences.

Requirements

  • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial analysis, ideally in investment banking, M&A, and/or debt financing.
  • Advanced skills in financial modelling and analytical tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portugues (mandatory).
  • Spanish is a plus
  • Proactive, versatile, and curious profile with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Commitment to sustainability and diversity values.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to take on new tasks according to business needs.

  • Ciclo de vida de projetos de IA: Vivência em projetos de IA, desde o levantamento de requisitos e desenho da solução até os testes, implantação e monitoramento;
  • Ambientes de nuvem: Conhecimento nos ecossistemas de nuvem que suportam as ferramentas, como Microsoft Azure e Google Cloud Platform.

Perfil comportamental:

  • Resolução de problemas: Excelente capacidade analítica para entender cenários de negócio complexos e traduzi-los em soluções de IA eficazes e escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara: Habilidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara e objetiva tanto para equipes técnicas quanto para stakeholders e clientes com perfis não técnicos;
  • Aprendizado contínuo: Proatividade e uma forte paixão por se manter atualizado sobre as rápidas evoluções no campo da IA;
  • Foco no cliente: Mentalidade de consultor, com foco em entender as dores do cliente e em entregar soluções que gerem valor real para o negócio;
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe: Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;

title: Engineer II, Senior Technology- Marine/ Mechanical/ Environmental
description:
Description

Are you passionate about being at the forefront of emerging technologies in the maritime and offshore industries?  
 

ABS is a leading Classification Society driven by its mission to promote the security of life and property and preserve the natural environment. In fulfilling this mission, ABS leads research and develops guidance and requirements focused on the safety of implementing new technology in the marine and offshore environment. 
 

As a Marine/ Mechanical / Environmental Engineer, you will be actively engaged in driving industry-leading research and development associated with machinery and systems for marine and offshore applications. 
 

What You Will Do:

  • Lead research and assess the maturity of new technologies in the marine industry related to carbon capture, CO2 transportation, non-carbon/ low carbon-based fuels, renewable energies including different machinery and systems etc.). 
  • Establish guidance and classification requirements for the marine and offshore industry on the application of new technology. 
  • Support ABS technical community on queries regarding different onboard mechanical equipment and systems.
  • Maintain and demonstrate thought leadership through technical publications and presentations. 
  • Participate in industry societies to develop and enhance technical capabilities. 
  • Remains knowledgeable of new scientific methods and developments affecting the technical scope of assigned responsibilities and recommends changes in engineering processes and programs as warranted by such developments. 
  • Devises new approaches to problems encountered and recommends changes in methods, procedures, or design where necessary. 
  • Monitors the technical quality, content, consistency, continuity, and timeliness of action of all assigned projects. 
  • Maintains liaison with other engineering specialists, internally and externally. 
  • Assist Principal Engineer and/or immediate superior in developing qualification statements, proposals, bids, and other presentation materials. 
  • Promotes ABS Quality System within an assigned group of engineers.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of five (5) years relevant engineering experience in the energy industry, shipyard, design/consulting company, shipping/oil company, university, or classification society.
  • Minimum of a bachelor's degree in mechanical/ marine/ environmental engineering or other related discipline; M.S. is preferred.
  • Having experience or knowledge with AI as it relates to mechanical/maritime concepts is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of onboard machinery and systems is a plus, including emerging technologies such as carbon capture (both pre- and post-combustion), CO2 transportation, ammonia crackers, methane reformers, methane slip, renewable energies, electrolyzers, and energy-saving devices.  Also, basic understanding of marine piping systems (e.g., fresh water, sea water, lubrication oil, fuel oil, compressed air, hydraulic system, cryogenics piping, etc. 
  • Knowledge of general mechanical systems. 
  • General knowledge of environmental engineering. 
  • Awareness of alternative marine fuels, such as hydrogen, ammonia, methanol, synthetic fuel, and biofue,l etc.
  • Awareness of fuel cell technology and application. 
  • Awareness of emerging technologies and trends in the marine industry, including emerging engines, fuels, power generation, and energy savings. 
  • Strong communicator with excellent oral and written communication skills. 
  • Excellent command of the English language. 
  • Demonstrated ability to work well with others. 
  • Ability to learn the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships:

This position reports to a Senior or Manager level position or above.

Nosso modelo é baseado em resultado real — o cliente só nos remunera após o primeiro ganho comprovado.

Nos últimos 12 meses, crescemos mais de 500%, abrimos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Porto Alegre e, desde julho/2025, iniciamos operação nos Estados Unidos (NY e Massachusetts).

Nossa meta é estar em todos os estados brasileiros até dezembro de 2026, mantendo o foco em crescimento sustentável e geração de resultados reais.

Sobre a Oportunidade

A FCX Consultoria Empresarial está em um momento de forte expansão e busca uma Analista de RH para ser protagonista na construção de um RH estratégico e humano.
O Analista de Atração e Retenção será responsável por conduzir de ponta a ponta os processos de Recrutamento e Seleção, atuando de forma consultiva junto às lideranças para identificar, atrair e engajar talentos alinhados à cultura da empresa. 
Cada contratação é vista como parte do nosso propósito de crescimento sustentável e fortalecimento da cultura FCX. 

Responsabilidades

· Conduzir processos de Recrutamento e Seleção end-to-end (da definição de perfil ao fechamento).

· Aplicar e corrigir testes psicológicos e comportamentais (assessments).

· Realizar entrevistas por competência e fit cultural.

· Elaborar pareceres técnicos e devolutivas estruturadas.

· Apoiar líderes na definição de perfis e indicadores de performance.

· Acompanhar e mensurar indicadores de R&S (tempo de fechamento, NPS do candidato, qualidade da contratação).

· Participar de projetos de integração, clima e retenção de talentos.

· Contribuir para ações de employer branding e fortalecimento da cultura FCX.

Diferenciais

· Experiência em consultorias, escritórios corporativos ou empresas B2B.

· Atuação com indicadores de R&S e employer branding.

· Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis aplicadas ao RH.

title: analista ambiental sr_4920
description:
Sobre a Arcadis:

A Arcadis é a empresa líder mundial em soluções sustentáveis de design, engenharia e consultoria para ativos naturais e construídos. Somos mais de pessoas, em mais de 70 países, dedicadas a melhorar a qualidade de vida. Todos têm um papel importante a desempenhar. Com o poder de muitas mentes curiosas, podemos resolver os desafios mais complexos do mundo e ter um impacto ainda maiores juntos.

Descrição do cargo:

Atuará em projetos de Gerenciamento de Áreas Contaminadas, participando de todas as etapas, desde a investigação ambiental até a remediação. Suas atividades serão majoritariamente de escritório, com foco na elaboração de relatórios técnicos, propostas e apoio à liderança na condução e controle dos projetos.

Será responsável pelo acompanhamento das medições de terceiros e pela garantia da qualidade técnica dos entregáveis, contribuindo para o sucesso dos projetos e o atendimento aos requisitos ambientais e regulatórios.

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e revisar relatórios técnicos;
  • Elaboração de proposta, gerenciamento de terceiros;
  • Orientar e supervisionar equipes técnicas e de campo;
  • Apresentar resultados, status de projetos e recomendações técnicas
  • Relacionamento com Clientes.

Requisitos e experiência:

  • Formação: Engenheiro Ambiental, Geólogo, Engenheiro Químico ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês: Intermediário;
  • Conhecimentos softwares: Pacote Office Arcgis / Qgis, EVS, leapfrog (desejável);
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Gerenciamento em áreas contaminadas - GAC.

Por que escolher a Arcadis?

Só podemos alcançar nossos objetivos quando todos têm a capacidade de ser o melhor que podem ser. Acreditamos que a contribuição de todos é importante. É por isso que somos pioneiros em uma abordagem baseada em habilidades, onde você pode aproveitar suas experiências e conhecimento único para traçar seu caminho profissional e maximizar o impacto que podemos gerar juntos.

Você realizará um trabalho significativo e, não importa qual seja o cargo, ajudando a oferecer soluções sustentáveis para um planeta mais próspero. Faça sua marca, em sua carreira, colegas, clientes, vida e no mundo ao seu redor.

Juntos, podemos criar um legado duradouro.

Nosso Compromisso com Igualdade, Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento:

Queremos que você possa trazer o melhor de si para o trabalho todos os dias, é por isso que levamos a igualdade e a inclusão a sério e nos responsabilizamos por nossas ações. Nossa ambição é ser um empregador de escolha e oferecer um ótimo ambiente de trabalho para todas as nossas pessoas.

Junte-se à Arcadis. Crie um legado.

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Role Summary:

The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries, such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. In this position, the Field Service Technician (FST) offers real-time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment.

The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites. Our team of Field Service Technicians is the face of Flowserve and we rely on them to provide world-class service to our customers, creating a lasting competitive advantage for our products and services.

Responsibilities:

  •     Perform direct, in-person service calls in response to customer requests;

  •     Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly;

  •     Work side-by-side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required;

  •     Supervising the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly;

  •     Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule;

  •     Checking equipment before commissioning and start-up and evaluating performance during and after equipment start-up;

  •     Monitoring the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment;

  •     Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products;

  •     Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering;

  •     Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged;

  •     Other duties as assigned;

Requirements:

  •     Mechanical Technician with active CFT;

  •     Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry;

  •     Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment;

  •     Experience in installing mechanical equipment;

  •     Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc..;

  •     Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference;

  •     Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges;

  •     Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

  •     Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills;

  •     Intermediate English

  •     An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job;

  •     Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods;

  •     Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers;

  •     Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

Desirable Skills:

  •     Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable;

  •     Professional certifications in this area.

title: AI & Operations Logistics Specialist Internship In Bali
description:
AI & Operations Logistics Specialist – Rio de Janeiro


Fund Size: €90M USD 


Location: Bali, Indonesia (with global impact) 


Focus: Future-builders, meaningful innovation 


Start: ASAP 


Important Note: This is an unpaid internship. We don't cover accommodation, food, visa, or flights. What we offer? The chance to build skills that don't exist in textbooks, work on projects that matter, and live like the future leader you're meant to be. 


What You'll Do: Architect AI systems that orchestrate complex global operations with precision and efficiency, making supply chains more resilient, sustainable, and responsive to changing conditions. You'll develop machine learning models that can predict supply chain disruptions before they occur, optimize delivery routes in real time based on traffic, weather, and demand patterns, and coordinate thousands of moving pieces across multiple time zones and cultures. Your work involves building AI-powered inventory management systems that can balance cost efficiency with service levels, creating predictive maintenance algorithms that can prevent equipment failures before they impact operations, and developing optimization engines that can solve complex logistics puzzles involving multiple constraints and objectives. Additionally, you'll architect systems that can automatically reroute shipments around disruptions, build AI tools that can negotiate optimal contracts with suppliers and carriers, and create real-time visibility platforms that give stakeholders complete transparency into global operations. 


Why It's Cool: Operations is where AI shows its true power to transform the physical world, and you're building systems that could save companies millions while making global commerce more efficient and sustainable. The algorithms you create will influence how goods move around the world, how resources are allocated, and how quickly people can get the products they need. This is efficiency at a planetary scale, where your work will contribute to reducing waste, improving sustainability, and making global supply chains more resilient to disruptions. The skills you develop – understanding complex systems and optimizing them with AI – will make you invaluable to any organization that moves physical goods or manages complex operations. 


Bali Option: Optimize global supply chains from your tropical headquarters, where the natural efficiency of island ecosystems provides inspiration for your logistics algorithms. Solve complex logistics puzzles with ocean breezes, celebrate breakthrough optimizations with fellow problem-solvers at beach cafes, and find insights for your systems in the way local communities efficiently organize their markets and transportation. Network with successful logistics entrepreneurs, attend supply chain workshops with ocean views, and experience how strategic thinking can be enhanced by the right environment.

title: AI & Research Coordination Specialist Internship In bali
description:
AI & Research Coordination Specialist – Rio de Janeiro


Fund Size: €90M USD 


Location: Bali, Indonesia (with global impact) 


Focus: Future-builders, meaningful innovation 


Start: ASAP 


Important Note: This is an unpaid internship. We don't cover accommodation, food, visa, or flights. What do we offer? The chance to build skills that don't exist in textbooks, work on projects that matter, and live like the future leader you're meant to be. 


What You'll Do: Develop AI systems that accelerate scientific discovery by connecting researchers globally, identifying breakthrough opportunities, and automating key aspects of the research process. You'll build machine learning algorithms that can analyze vast amounts of scientific literature to identify research gaps, promising directions, and potential collaborations, while creating AI-powered project management tools that can coordinate complex research initiatives across multiple institutions and time zones. Your work involves developing intelligent literature review systems that can synthesize findings from thousands of papers, building AI tools that can identify the most promising research proposals and funding opportunities, and creating collaboration platforms that can match researchers with complementary expertise and interests. Additionally, you'll architect systems that can automate routine research tasks like data collection and preliminary analysis, build AI assistants that can help researchers design better experiments and interpret results, and develop impact prediction models that can forecast which research directions are most likely to yield breakthrough discoveries. 


Why It's Cool: You're literally speeding up human knowledge creation and scientific discovery through artificial intelligence. The systems you build could help researchers solve climate change, cure diseases, develop new technologies, and answer fundamental questions about our universe. This is impact at the highest level, where your work will contribute to accelerating the pace of human progress and helping humanity tackle its greatest challenges. The intersection of AI and scientific research is one of the most important frontiers in technology, where you'll be developing tools that amplify human intelligence and creativity in the pursuit of knowledge. 


Bali Option: Accelerate global research from paradise, where the contemplative atmosphere of Bali provides the perfect environment for deep thinking about complex scientific problems. Connect brilliant minds worldwide while enjoying tropical innovation vibes, debug research algorithms between surf sessions, and find inspiration for your systems in the way traditional Balinese communities organize knowledge and learning. Attend research workshops led by accomplished scientists, network with researchers from around the world, and experience how the right environment can enhance both analytical thinking and creative problem-solving in scientific contexts.

title: Consultor Técnico Vacinas Campanhas
description:
O Consultor Técnico de Vacinas Campanhas atua como especialista na execução das campanhas de vacinação adulta incluindo campanhas nacionais, institucionais e colaborativas.

Atua focando no engajamento de stakeholders externos com o objetivo de gerar oportunidades de campanhas e ampliar o alcance das ações de vacinação do adulto no Brasil, entendendo o ecossistema de saúde e do mercado de prevenção, e gerenciando adequadamente contas existentes e potenciais, tendo autonomia para a gestão dos recursos a seu cargo. Trabalha em sinergia com a equipe cross-funcional interna e externa para garantir o acesso adequado dos produtos GSK aos pacientes.

Essa posição ficará baseada em Brasília.

Suas responsabilidades:

Esse cargo dá a VOCÊ a oportunidade de liderar atividades chaves para progredir na SUA carreira, algumas delas são:

  • Condução de discussões técnicas com profissionais de saúde, farmacêuticos e clínicas sobre vacinas e prevenção de doenças;

  • Negociação com clientes e stakeholders, co-desenvolvendo campanhas e soluções personalizadas (protocolos, diretrizes, eventos, entre outros) que geram valor mútuo, com foco na adesão às campanhas e no aumento de pessoas imunizadas;

  • Identificação de pontos críticos e oportunidades de ações e campanhas que impactem positivamente a experiência e o resultado nas jornadas de prevenção;

  • Interpreta dados de mercado e gera insights estratégicos para apoiar decisões e campanhas;

  • Conhecer sobre modelos de campanhas de vacinação, gestão de eventos e alocação eficiente de recursos, de forma a ser capaz de avaliar a eficiência da campanha e adaptar ações às necessidades dos clientes e contas.

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações:
Estamos à procura de profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Ensino superior completo.

  • Experiência prévia na área comercial com foco em prospecção de novos clientes.

  • Conhecimento sobre patologias, gestão de clientes e gestão de território.

  • Proficiência no pacote Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).

  • Carteira de habilitação válida (categoria B).

  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Seu diferencial:

Contudo, se você tiver os requisitos a seguir, será um plus para a sua inscrição:

  • Experiência na área comercial de vacinas.

Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

When applying, you may also choose to provide personal information, which helps us ensure a more inclusive selection process. Rest assured, your information will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and will not be accessible to hiring managers. Let's keep maintaining an inclusive and welcoming workplace.

Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.

The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. Viridien ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are seeking passionate and innovative problem-solvers to join our Subsurface Imaging team at Viridien.

In this role, you will apply your expertise in math, physics, and technology to address real-world challenges that shape the future of energy, infrastructure, and Earth data solutions. Working alongside leading experts, you will contribute to projects that transform how we explore and understand our planet.

Through comprehensive training and mentorship, you will learn to convert raw seismic data into high-resolution 3D models of the Earth's subsurface—unlocking insights that support sustainable exploration and environmental protection.

In this role, you will:

  • Apply advanced physics, mathematics, and geoscience principles to process and interpret seismic data.
  • Use state-of-the-art imaging techniques and high-performance computing (HPC) to solve complex geophysical challenges.
  • Collaborate with diverse teams to design innovative algorithms, tools, and workflows.
  • Partner with Research and Software Development teams to shape next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, present findings, and drive innovation across the field

About the Team

You will join a diverse and innovative group of professionals tackling some of the world's most complex geophysical challenges. Our collaborative environment fosters creativity, knowledge-sharing, and professional growth. You will have opportunities to work on pioneering research, contribute to publications, and develop new technologies in a fast-paced, high-impact setting

Qualifications:

  • PhD or Master's in Geophysics, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

title: Evolved Packet Core
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

As a Network Architect, in the Network Team, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, in the functional domain of Evolved Packet Core and 5G SA Core.

You will be responsible for preparing, designing, testing, and delivering new solutions or enhancements to the existing product portfolio. Additionally, you will define and support the technology evolution roadmap for systems within the assigned functional area and domain, while also actively participating in and supporting cross-functional projects in collaboration with other functional areas.
Key Responsibilities

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry. Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

Must Have

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of Packet Core systems, including P-GW, RADIUS, DNS, PCRF, ePDG, DRA
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining roaming interconnects for GRX/IPX
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Experience in deploying VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience in designing, implementing, testing and troubleshooting the following interfaces: Gx, RADIUS, SGi/Gi, Gy, Bp, S6b, S2b, SWm, Sxb
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online).
  • Experience in Policy control, including DPI and PCRF policy creation
  • Experience with IoT, including LTE-M and NB-IoT
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as RADIUS, GTP-C, GTP-U, Diameter, MAP, S6a
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice to Have

  • +8 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • +3 years in a telecom strategy role
  • Experience in 5G Core design, implementation and operation
  • Previous experience with Nokia and Affirmed Networks EPC products

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial em Inspeção, Verificação, Testes e Certificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com colaboradores no mundo, contamos com escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui  aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. title: Finance Analyst
description:
Objective of the role
The Finance Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analysis and structuring of financing transactions, assessing market rates, debt and equity alternatives, and applying advanced financial models. The position is expected to contribute to the design of financial strategies aligned with corporate goals, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality decision-making.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain financial models for corporate and project transactions, including the use of financing Model A.
  • Review and validate financial models prepared by external advisors, ensuring consistency with company assumptions and industry best practices.
  • Analyse and validate technical and financial assumptions together with specialised teams, assessing their impact on results.
  • Conduct market rate analysis and evaluate its effect on projects and financing structures.
  • Assess financing options (debt and equity), supporting the structuring and negotiation of alternatives.
  • Support capital raising processes (debt and equity), including the preparation of financial materials, participation in due diligence, and interaction with investors and financial institutions.
  • Prepare and contribute to capital presentations for investors, the board of directors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with internal departments (technical, legal, commercial) and external advisors to ensure timely and accurate information flow.
  • Conduct market and risk analysis to support investment and financing decisions.
  • Prepare financial reports, presentations, and executive summaries for management, investors, and other relevant audiences.
Requirements
  • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial analysis, ideally in investment banking, M&A, and/or debt financing.
  • Advanced skills in financial modelling and analytical tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portugues (mandatory).
  • Spanish is a plus

Descrição de Cargo

Buscamos um Líder de SAP BTP altamente qualificado e inovador para comandar nossa estratégia de desenvolvimento e integração na nuvem. Este profissional desempenhará um papel central em nossa jornada de transformação digital para o SAP S/4HANA. Como arquiteto e ponto de referência para todas as soluções desenvolvidas na SAP BTP, garantirá que as extensões e inovações suportem robustamente as necessidades do negócio, especialmente no dinâmico setor de energia elétrica.

Responsabilidades 

  • Definir e executar a visão estratégica para o uso da SAP BTP, estabelecendo um roadmap de inovações e garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio e a arquitetura de TI corporativa.
  • Desenhar e governar a arquitetura de soluções end-to-end na SAP BTP, incluindo integração de aplicações (Cloud Integration), desenvolvimento de extensões (CAP/RAP), gestão de APIs e implementação de soluções de análise de dados (SAP Analytics Cloud).
  • Liderar as frentes de trabalho de extensibilidade durante a implementação do S/4HANA, utilizando a BTP para desenvolver customizações que mantenham o core do S/4HANA limpo.
  • Atuar como um catalisador para a adoção de Inteligência Artificial, explorando serviços de SAP AI Core e SAP AI Business Services para otimizar processos, criar análises preditivas e desenvolver novos produtos e serviços.
  • Liderar equipes de desenvolvimento, gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos projetos na BTP, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, orçamentos e padrões de qualidade.
  • Identificar oportunidades e desenhar soluções na BTP que atendam a desafios específicos do setor, como gestão de ativos (EAM), medição inteligente e comercialização de energia.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins. 
  • Comprovada experiência liderando projetos e desenhando soluções na SAP BTP, com profundo conhecimento em serviços como Cloud Integration, SAP CAP/RAP, SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • Participação ativa em projetos de implementação ou transformação para SAP S/4HANA, com entendimento da estratégia de extensibilidade e do conceito "Keep the Core Clean".
  • Sólida experiência como arquiteto de soluções, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas complexas, escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento profundo dos processos e desafios tecnológicos do setor de energia elétrica.
  • Capacidade de liderar, inspirar e mentorar equipes, além de gerenciar stakeholders em todos os níveis.
  • Habilidade de comunicação e apresentação, capaz de traduzir conceitos técnicos para audiências de negócio e TI.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações SAP BTP, S/4HANA ou em Arquitetura de Software (como TOGAF).

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA.

The Senior Automation Engineer is responsible for working with our customers to design solutions to control, monitor and automate their industrial processes. Job Description:

The Legal Counsel is a key member of the Brazil C&P Legal Team, supporting the Production and Operations business by providing day-to-day legal advice on upstream matters, especially in Brazil. Responsibilities include advising on bid round qualifications, pre- and post-tender negotiations, agreements, regulatory analysis, JV management, and drafting and negotiating a variety of commercial contracts. The role requires adapting to regulatory changes, ensuring consistency with BP US/UK legal standards, managing multiple complex projects, and representing the business in industry associations and government bodies. Candidates must hold a law degree from a top-tier Brazilian university with active OAB, possess upstream experience from specialized law firms or oil & gas companies, and demonstrate fluency in English, with expertise in oil & gas contracts, strategic legal risk management, and stakeholder influence in matrix organizations.

Key Results / Accountabilities

- Responsible for providing day to day legal advice on legal matters involving Upstream businesses in the region, especially in Brazil.

- Provide legal advice and support the business in bid round qualification, supporting pre- and post-tender negotiations, agreements and regulatory analysis.

- Legal support to the business in Joint Venture management.

- Drafting, reviewing and supporting the negotiation of commercial contracts such as services, distributor, product supply, logistics, sales and power agreements.

- Represent the business supported in class association and government bodies when needed.

Key challenges faced on the role

Adapt to changes.

Follow up on recent changes in the regulation.

Ensure consistency between Brazil and BP US/UK legal requirements.

Prioritize resources and manage workload between the ongoing matters/projects.

Deal with multiple complex matters at same time.

Comfortable supporting within operational tasks as needed

Experience and Expertise

Law Degree from a top tier Brazilian university with active OAB.

5+ years of proven senior experience

Upstream experience with expertise in managing profit-sharing agreements during both the development and production phases.

English (fluent)

Spanish (will be considered a PLUS)

Experience in top tier law firm or oil & gas company (operator and non-operator)

South America (except for Argentina)

Required Competencies

Strategic Legal Risk Management: Ability to anticipate, assess, and mitigate legal risks in complex, high-stakes environments, especially during rapid expansion phases and under cost constraints.

Business-Oriented Legal Advice: Skill in delivering pragmatic, commercially aligned legal guidance that supports operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.

Stakeholder Influence in Matrix Organizations: Strong communication and negotiation skills to navigate cross-functional teams, global reporting lines, and diverse cultural contexts.

Expertise in Oil & Gas Contracts and Regulatory Frameworks: Deep understanding of Brazilian upstream agreements (e.g., profit-sharing, joint ventures), local energy regulations, related areas such as environmental, compliance and labor.

Agility and Resilience Under Pressure: Capacity to manage high workloads, shifting priorities, and urgent matters with composure and adaptability.

Cost-Conscious Delivery Excellence: Demonstrated ability to drive legal outcomes that balance cost-efficiency with high-quality execution demonstrating smart resourcing, process optimization, and strategic prioritization to meet business needs without compromising standards.

title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição no Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O/a Gerente de Projeto atuará como responsável pela gestão do ciclo relativo à execução de projeto no Rio de Janeiro, com uma abordagem integrada relativa aos aspectos ligados a implementação e administração. Sua principal função é desenvolver o projeto de acordo com o tempo, prazo, escopo e conteúdo estabelecido junto com Cliente administrando equipe e recurso para tal escopo. title: ENGENHEIRO TÉCNICO DE PRODUTO FOCO EM TECIDO PLANO
description:
Estamos com uma posição para Engenheiro técnico de produto com foco em tecido plano. Suas atividades estarão voltadas para o desenvolvimento, melhoria e controle de qualidade de produtos têxteis, atuando em diversas etapas do processo de criação e fabricação, garantindo que os produtos atendam aos requisitos técnicos e de mercado.

Atribuições e responsabilidades:

  1. Análise e Desenvolvimento de Produto
    • Desenvolver protótipos de novos produtos, considerando o design, materiais, funcionalidades e estética.
    • Elaborar fichas técnicas detalhadas com todas as especificações do produto (materiais, cores, tamanhos, acabamentos, técnicas de costura, etc.).
    • Avaliar e selecionar materiais adequados para cada tipo de produto, garantindo qualidade e adequação à funcionalidade do design.
  2. Processo de Produção
    • Definir os processos produtivos necessários para fabricar os produtos conforme os requisitos de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
    • Ajustar padrões de produção, como cortes, modelagem e costura, para garantir que o produto final atenda às especificações.
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção, identificar possíveis problemas técnicos e sugerir soluções para otimizar o processo.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Realizar inspeções durante e após a produção para verificar se os produtos atendem aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
    • Coordenar ou realizar testes de durabilidade, resistência, lavagem e outros parâmetros técnicos para assegurar a conformidade do produto final.
    • Identificar e tratar desvios de qualidade, propondo melhorias ou ajustes nos processos produtivos ou de design.
  4. Ajustes e Melhorias Contínuas
    • Coletar feedback de clientes, áreas de vendas e outras partes envolvidas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos.
    • Propor melhorias no processo de produção visando reduzir custos, melhorar a eficiência e garantir a qualidade.
    • Acompanhar inovações tecnológicas no setor têxtil e sugerir a implementação de novas técnicas ou equipamentos que melhorem o produto ou o processo produtivo.
  5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica
    • Atualizar constantemente as fichas técnicas, garantindo que as informações estejam corretas e acessíveis para as equipes de produção e comercialização.
    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.
  6. Interação com Outras Áreas
    • Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de design e estilistas para garantir que as ideias criativas sejam viáveis do ponto de vista técnico e de produção.
    • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial, ajudando a explicar os diferenciais e especificações dos produtos aos clientes ou consumidores.
    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.
    • Garantir que os produtos atendam às normas de segurança, regulamentos ambientais e padrões internacionais de qualidade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia têxtil;

Experiência em varejo de moda, com foco em tecido plano.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.


What we are looking for
  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure Pipelines, incorporating security and performance testing
  • Expertise in Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with Datadog strongly preferred, including real-time alerting and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with Hub-and-Spoke network architecture and cloud security principles
  • Strong database administration experience with Azure SQL Server, including cloud-based backup, replication, and high-availability strategies. Experience with the Hyperscale service tier is a strong plus.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, incident management, and high-availability architectures
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, including security compliance, role-based access control, and vulnerability management
  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.
  • Ability to thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced remote work environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience supporting a remote team
  • Azure and/or Security certification(s) a plus
Responsibilities
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

    • Supervisionar a equipe de corte, garantindo que todos os colaboradores cumpram os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos.

    • Garantir que os cortes sejam realizados com precisão, seguindo os moldes e especificações do design.
    • Identificar e corrigir problemas de qualidade no corte, como falhas nos moldes ou irregularidades no tecido.
    • Realizar inspeções regulares para verificar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade estabelecidas pela empresa.
  4. Acompanhamento de Produção
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção e verificar se o cronograma de corte está sendo cumprido.
    • Resolver eventuais problemas que possam surgir durante o processo, como falta de material, erro no corte, ou necessidade de ajustes no molde.

    • Garantir que os custos com o processo de corte estejam dentro do orçamento estabelecido.
  7. Segurança e Normas
    • Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos, minimizando riscos de acidentes durante o processo de corte.

Cultura da Empresa:

Responsabilidades Chave:

Como Product Manager, você desempenhará um papel crucial no desenvolvimento de nossos produtos e na entrega de valor aos clientes. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Liderar o ciclo de vida de produtos específicos dentro de um time ágil, trabalhando de perto com equipes multidisciplinares.

  • Colaborar com stakeholders e equipes multifuncionais para definir a visão, estratégia e roadmaps de produtos que atendam às necessidades do negócio e dos clientes.

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando recursos e tarefas com base no valor de negócio, garantindo que os recursos mais valiosos sejam desenvolvidos primeiro.

  • Especificar requisitos de produto, detalhando funcionalidades, fluxos de trabalho e definições de conceitos por meio de processos de descoberta.

  • Realizar análises de mercado e de concorrentes, identificando oportunidades de melhorias e inovações no produto.

  • Facilitar sessões de brainstorming e workshops para definição de funcionalidades e aprimoramento do produto.

  • Monitorar e analisar métricas de desempenho, coletando feedback do usuário e ajustando a estratégia do produto conforme necessário.

  • Apoiar a equipe de desenvolvimento na resolução de problemas e remoção de impedimentos durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento.

  • Melhorar processos internos, identificando ineficiências e implementando soluções para otimizar o fluxo de trabalho.

Requisitos Desejados:

Para se destacar como nosso Product Manager, procuramos alguém com as seguintes qualificações:

  • Experiência em gerenciamento de produto ou posições similares.

  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban.

  • Capacidade de entender tanto as necessidades do negócio quanto as considerações técnicas, facilitando a comunicação entre equipes multidisciplinares.

  • Experiência em especificação de requisitos, desenvolvimento de fluxos de trabalho e definição de conceitos.

  • Conhecimento em análise de mercado e concorrentes.

  • Habilidade em conduzir sessões de brainstorming e workshops.

Competências Essenciais:

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, capazes de traduzir a visão do produto em tarefas acionáveis para a equipe de desenvolvimento.

  • Pensamento crítico e habilidades analíticas para avaliar dados e feedback do usuário e tomar decisões informadas.

  • Aptidão para tomar decisões baseadas em dados, garantindo que os recursos sejam priorizados com base no valor de negócio e no impacto nos clientes.

  • Capacidade de analisar e melhorar processos internos para aumentar a eficiência e eficácia.

Totalpass;

On hotel location – 20% remote, travelling expected within country.

This role will support the Legal Director in a variety of corporate legal matters, including the setup and management of legal entities, corporate governance, share transactions, global trademark filings, and coordination with external counsel for different projects. The legal counsel will also work closely with the finance and HR departments to facilitate bank account openings and assist with immigration and labor processes. Key Responsibilities:

  1. Corporate Governance, Entity Management & Legal Representation:

    1. Provide legal support for real estate transactions, including reviewing contracts, leases, and other real estate agreements under the supervision of the Legal Operations Manager.
    2. Assist with obtaining necessary permits and approvals for business operations, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations.
  3. Database Management:
    1. Maintain an organized and up-to-date database in Google Drive with all legal documentation as required by the Legal Director.
    2. Ensure all documents are compliant with company policies and accessible to the Legal Director and relevant stakeholders.
  4. External Counsel Coordination & Billing Management:
    1. Support the Legal Director in coordinating the work of external counsel in various jurisdictions.
    2. Help monitor external counsel fees and legal project budgets.
  5. Collaboration with the Finance and HR Department:
    1. Assist the finance department in the opening of bank accounts for new legal entities by providing the necessary legal documentation, filling out forms, and ensuring compliance with local banking regulations.
    2. Support immigration processes by procuring all legal documentation for visa applications and work permits.
    3. Assist in matters related to labor law, including ensuring compliance with employee rights and contracts.

    1. Assist the Legal Director and/or Legal Managers with various legal projects and provide general support as needed.

title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

Coordenar, planejar e supervisionar todas as atividades operacionais, administrativas e estratégicas de uma ou mais unidades de negócio. Este profissional é responsável por garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas, otimizando os recursos disponíveis, incluindo equipe, orçamento e infraestrutura. Além disso, deve identificar oportunidades de melhoria, minimizar riscos, sugerir estratégias de crescimento sustentável e assegurar a excelência no atendimento ao cliente, promovendo a rentabilidade e o desenvolvimento contínuo das unidades.

Responsabilidades principais

  1. Gestão Operacional : Supervisionar a equipe de coleta sanguínea e vacinação, garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas e protocolos de saúde, controlar o fluxo de atendimento ao cliente, acompanhar rotina de agendamentos, atendimentos, triagem e coletas, além de auditar e contribuir com a organização do posto de coleta e sala de vacinação.

  8. Planejamento Estratégico : Propor melhorias, identificar oportunidades de expansão, acompanhar tendências de mercado, planejar ações para satisfação e fidelização de clientes.

Requisitos

Escolaridade: Superior completo em Farmácia, Enfermagem ou Biomedicina.
Desejável: Pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas, Gestão Laboratorial ou Análises Clínicas.

Será um diferencial: experiência em coleta de sangue, punção venosa em adultos e crianças, e aplicação de vacinas.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness
Optional things we value
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns
